title: Critique: practical needs have no metaphysical priority

statements.text: Kim denies ranking physicalism as more certain than mental causation. The issue is metaphysical, not epistemic, priority, and practical epistemic needs must not dictate the fundamental structure of reality, which is to be read from theoretical reason, science and the metaphysics that goes with it.

sources.quote: I believe that our own practical epistemic needs must not take metaphysical priority over what we believe to be the fundamental structure of reality
